Subject: Holdlist recovery: Acme Health commit review & contingency plan

Team —

Quick reminder ahead of Monday's forecast rollup: Acme Health is sitting on the holdlist (yellow -> red risk if we don’t get stage updates). I attached the quarter holdlist workbook with current stage, expected close date, and our suggested save-plan.

Ask: Please do the following by EOD Monday (23 Aug) so Finance can lock the commit:
- Update the "Stage" column to the current stage and add the reason code (no guesswork).
- For deals flagged red/yellow, add a one-line save plan and owner in the "Contingency" column.
- If there are procurement blockers, flag them and attach the vendor questionnaire or timeline.

Specifics for ACME:
- Current rep: Marissa Cole — please confirm the new SOW timing and whether DocuSign version 1.2 is acceptable to procurement.
- Procurement said they have an internal review window of 5 business days after SOW acceptance. If that's still the case, we need a fallback model that reduces initial capacity commitment.

I will escalate any deals that remain on red by Tuesday morning. Reply-all with updates so we have a public trail.

Attachments: ACME_Holdlist_2027Q3.xlsx, SOW-AcmeHealth-v1.2.docx

Thanks,
Priyom

Thanks Priyom — updating now. Quick ACME specifics:
- Spoke to Sarah (legal loop) and Kyra (procurement). They received SOW v1.2 and asked for two small redlines (data retention clause + SLA uptime wording). They expect to return redlines by Wed (25 Aug).
- Procurement timeline: still ~5 business days after SOW acceptance but they want signature-ready doc this week to stay on that timeline.

My proposed save-plan (entered into the workbook):
- Keep as "Commit" if redlines are minor and accepted by end of day Thu (26 Aug).
- If redlines expand (new clauses > 2 items), move to "Commit with Contingency" and offer a 30-day initial ramp with 50% reserved capacity (pricing impact: see note in workbook).

I’m looping Sarah so procurement can confirm their internal schedule. Sarah / Kyra — can you confirm whether the two redlines are the only items and whether you can get those back to us by end of Wednesday?
